items.title: iCloud Calendar abused to send phishing emails from Apple’s servers
items.description: iCloud Calendar invites are being abused to send callback phishing emails disguised as purchase notifications directly from Apple's email servers, making them more likely to bypass spam filters to land in targets' inboxes. [...]

items.title: Czech cyber agency warns against Chinese tech in critical infrastructure
items.description: The Czech Republic's National Cyber and Information Security Agency (NUKIB) is instructing critical infrastructure organizations in the country to avoid using Chinese technology or transferring user data to servers located in China. [...]
